description: CsNaGe₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Cs sites. In the first Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to two Na and six Ge atoms. There is one shorter (3.65 Å) and one longer (3.68 Å) Cs-Na bond length. There are a spread of Cs-Ge bond distances ranging from 3.77-4.01 Å. In the second Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to two Na and eight Ge atoms. There is one shorter (3.64 Å) and one longer (3.72 Å) Cs-Na bond length. There are a spread of Cs-Ge bond distances ranging from 3.76-4.21 Å. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two Cs and six Ge atoms. There are a spread of Na-Ge bond distances ranging from 2.94-3.33 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to two Cs and seven Ge atoms. There are a spread of Na-Ge bond distances ranging from 3.10-3.31 Å. There are four inequivalent Ge sites. In the first Ge site, Ge is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to four Cs, three Na, and three Ge atoms. There are a spread of Ge-Ge bond distances ranging from 2.52-2.61 Å. In the second Ge site, Ge is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to three Cs, three Na, and three Ge atoms. There is one shorter (2.54 Å) and one longer (2.59 Å) Ge-Ge bond length. In the third Ge site, Ge is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to four Cs, three Na, and three Ge atoms. The Ge-Ge bond length is 2.60 Å. In the fourth Ge site, Ge is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to three Cs, four Na, and three Ge atoms.
